description: What a document window may use: Tauri's core defaults; dragging and titling the window, closing it after asking about unsaved edits, and bringing it to the front to ask; setting the app's appearance, light, dark or the system's, as Preferences say (src/window-theme.ts); the open and save dialogs; reading the clipboard's text, for Paste as Plain Text; the three file commands the app calls (read a file, ask whether a file exists, write a text file), with the file plugin's denials of the webview's own data. Nothing of the updater: the app checks for, downloads and installs an update itself, for every window (src/updates.rs), and a window only asks it to, through the app's own commands. They reach no file by themselves, only the files the person opened or saved: the app adds each to the scope, as the dialog plugin does for a file picked in an open or save dialog (src/file_scope.rs). Nothing of the file plugin's watching either, which would have to reach a document's folder: the app watches a window's document for it, through the document's folder, and tells it of changes to that file alone (src/watch.rs).
